projects.title: Nexa Properties
projects.shortDescription: Business website designed with a clean structure and conversion-focused property enquiry journey.
projects.description: A premium real estate website concept designed to make properties easy to discover and enquiries easy to complete. The structure combines clear property pathways, trust-building content and prominent enquiry points without overwhelming the visitor.
projects.alt: Nexa Properties real estate website concept

projects.title: Northstar Solar
projects.shortDescription: Landing page designed to turn paid traffic into quote requests and qualified enquiries.
projects.description: A focused solar enquiry page built around a clear savings proposition and a simple quote journey. Benefit-led content, trust signals and a prominent savings calculator help move high-intent visitors toward the next step.
projects.alt: Northstar Solar enquiry landing page concept

projects.title: Searchwave Google Ads
projects.shortDescription: Search campaign setup focused on reaching high-intent potential customers.
projects.description: A Google Ads campaign concept structured around high-intent search terms, relevant ad groups and measurable enquiry actions. The approach prioritises search relevance, budget clarity and a direct path from each ad to a focused landing experience.
projects.alt: Searchwave Google Ads campaign dashboard concept

projects.title: Vertex Consulting
projects.shortDescription: Professional services website structured to build trust and guide visitors toward a consultation.
projects.description: A credible B2B website concept that turns a broad consulting offer into clear, easy-to-scan pathways. The page hierarchy balances expertise and business outcomes, with consultation prompts placed at natural decision points.

projects.title: Apex Fitness
projects.shortDescription: High-energy landing page built to promote memberships and drive trial bookings.
projects.description: A membership acquisition page designed to communicate energy without sacrificing clarity. Programme benefits, coaching support and membership actions are organised around one goal: converting campaign visitors into trial bookings.
projects.alt: Apex Fitness membership landing page concept

projects.title: ProspectFlow Lead Generation
projects.shortDescription: Lead generation system designed to identify, qualify and reach relevant prospects.
projects.description: A B2B lead-generation workflow concept covering audience definition, prospect research, qualification and outreach. The system is designed to create a more consistent prospect pipeline while keeping relevance and lead quality ahead of volume.
projects.alt: ProspectFlow B2B lead generation dashboard concept

projects.title: Atlas Legal
projects.shortDescription: Clean, credible business website with clear service pathways and focused enquiry points.
projects.description: A professional services website concept built to make complex legal services feel clear and approachable. Practice-area pathways, concise proof points and discreet enquiry prompts create a confident experience for potential clients.
projects.alt: Atlas Legal professional services website concept

projects.title: Lumina Wellness
projects.shortDescription: Focused campaign page with clear benefits, trust signals and a simple appointment enquiry flow.
projects.description: A calm, conversion-focused landing page concept for a wellness clinic. The design uses accessible service information, reassuring proof and a low-friction appointment form to help visitors move from interest to enquiry.
projects.alt: Lumina Wellness appointment landing page concept

projects.title: Signal Digital Marketing
projects.shortDescription: Marketing setup focused on generating traffic, enquiries and qualified leads.
projects.description: A practical digital marketing framework connecting campaign traffic, landing-page performance and lead tracking. The concept brings the most useful metrics into one view so decisions stay focused on enquiries and business growth rather than vanity metrics.
projects.alt: Signal digital marketing performance dashboard concept

about.introduction: My background is a combination of sales, business development and digital marketing, with a strong focus on understanding customer requirements and turning them into practical marketing and lead-generation solutions.
about.storyLead: I started my professional career in sales, where I learned how businesses find customers, understand their needs and convert enquiries into sales.
about.story:
Over time, I developed a strong interest in digital marketing and started building skills in website design, Google Ads, lead generation and marketing automation.

Today, I combine my sales experience with digital marketing skills to help businesses improve their online presence and generate qualified enquiries.
about.mission: Help businesses build a stronger online presence and create a practical system for generating and converting leads.
about.differentiator: Look at marketing from both sides: the business side and the customer side.
about.differentiatorDescription: I focus on building websites and marketing systems that are designed around the customer’s journey, from the first click to the final enquiry.
